nom: Organic Rose Water Spray for Face

segments.dry: The one reviewer who describes her skin as dry reports she uses the spray daily for gentle hydration and finds it relieves the tight feeling her skin gets, especially as a step before moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: The reviewer who describes her skin as sensitive reports the spray is gentle and calming with no irritation, used daily as part of her routine.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the spray leaves skin feeling hydrated, refreshed, and soothed, including one with dry skin who uses it daily for gentle hydration and relief from tightness, though one reviewer notes it can dry down slightly tight on its own and recommends following with a moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the spray helped reduce some redness she had been having around her nose after about a week of using it as a toner.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with acne scarring and occasional hormonal breakouts reports her skin texture looked smoother and glowier after a few nights of use, and another reviewer reports her face has stayed clear while using the spray, though neither draws a firm conclusion about breakouts specifically.

aspects.libelle: Rose scent too weak for some
Some sprayers dispense unevenly or feel flimsy
Spray top sometimes missing on arrival

extraits.texte: Very disappointed. Let me explain why I do believe it matters. The human body is filled with microplastics. I preferred this bottle for three reasons. 1st, we use castor oil in our house for many reasons and health benefits as well as surgical healing. 2nd we only buy from USA made products. This bottle is not squared and made in America and is only bottled here. This means it’s much harder for the USDA to certify organic. Certified organic also has little meaning these days and the bar is so low for “organic” that it’s easy to be deceived. Another very large problem is I was mislead. The picture clearly shows “glass bottle”. Castor oil is a penetrating oil and can break down tissue internally in the body. So housing castor oil in plastic containers is unacceptable. My wife is incredibly disappointed and so am I. We needed this for today and had it expressed delivered to only find out it’s a PLASTIC BOTTLE. Why lie to your customers and post the only image of the product with “GLASS BOTTLE”. It obviously matters to customers. It matters to us. Also, why put a beautiful American flag on it when it is not sourced and made in the USA. Sure it’s bottled here but not made. Just more deception. Will not purchase again and will stick with our previous brand we love that meets every all the perimeters I just described.

extraits.titre: Pure, Refreshing Rose Water with a Clean Formula
extraits.texte: I’ve been using the Ella & Eden Organic Rose Water spray daily, and it’s quickly become a staple in my routine. The mist is very fine and evenly distributed, making it refreshing without feeling heavy or sticky. It provides a light boost of hydration and works well as a mid-day face refresher or after cleansing. What I appreciate most is the simple, clean ingredient profile. It’s truly alcohol-free with no added fragrances or additives, and the natural rose scent is soft and subtle—not overpowering. My skin is on the sensitive side, and this has been gentle and calming with no irritation. I’ve also used it on my hair to help refresh dry ends and tame flyaways, and it adds a nice touch of softness. The glass bottle feels high quality and helps keep the product fresh. Overall, this is a versatile, well-made rose water that’s easy to incorporate into everyday face and hair care routines.

extraits.titre: Lovely rose water. No sprayer included.
extraits.texte: This rose water is very nice. It feels very nice on my face when I use the rose water as a toner. After using it for about a week, I think it has helped with some redness that I have been having around my nose. I received this rose water glass bottle without any sprayer included so I had to recycle one of favorite face toner mist bottle and dumped the content of this rose water into it. For this reason I deducted a star as the product came incomplete. Otherwise, I would definitely order this product again. It's reasonably priced and very good quality.

I forgot how much I loved using rosewater on my face until I picked up this product again! A little bit about my skin: early 30s, acne scarring and mild hormonal acne breakouts on occasion, texture, early signs of fine lines. I try to use all-natural products as much as possible for my overall health, as well as avoiding any hormones disruptions. I have used this product as part of my evening skincare for 3 nights in a row so far and am ALREADY seeing a positive change in my skin. The texture is softening and smoothing out, and my skin is definitely glowier and smoother as a result. This product is by no means a "miracle" product - don't expect to wake up looking like an airbrushed celebrity - but it is a great addition to my skincare routine. Pros: - Comes in a tinted glass bottle - no sneaky microplastics! - Comes with a separate spritzer cap along with the standard reusable screw-on cap, so you can choose how you want to use it. (Personally, I threw away the screw-on cap and just leave the spray cap on.) - Sweet, light floral smell from the natural floral essences of the product- if you're used to most clean rosewater toners and products, then this one shouldn't bother you. - Easy to use - just spritz on your face with the spritzer OR unscrew and pour on to a cotton pad (avoid cotton balls that will soak up too much of the product). I prefer using a cotton pad to avoid product waste by spraying the product, as some of it ended up in my hair or on the wall behind me. - Made
Exceptional product for skin. Dries slightly tightly, so when used with moisturizer it provides an excellent surface for makeup or bare skin.

I received this about a week ago, it has a beautiful rose scent and is refreshing to put on my face. I haven’t noticed any skin differences but my face is clear. My bottle did come without the pump, I contacted the company via email to ask for one and they provided prompt, exceptional customer service to make it right. So far, I like this and I would order again.

reserve: Most reviewers describe general impressions of scent and hydration without naming a specific skin type, so segment and concern coverage here is narrower than for products with more self-described reviews.
